skins.name: Adventure Time (BMO Terminal)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Mathematical! BMO handheld aesthetic featuring seafoam chassis, thick cartoon outlines, D-pad accents, and Finn & Jake roaming characters.

skins.name: Cyberpunk 2077 (Arasaka Kiroshi HUD)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: High-contrast Night City cyberware optical telemetry. Features chamfered carbon bezels, vibrant Cyber Yellow accents, glitch scanlines, and Silverhand silhouettes.

skins.name: Dexter's Laboratory (Secret Mainframe)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Mid-century retro-future scientific mainframe. Features purple-glove accents, radioactive neon green indicators, industrial hazard trim, and Dexter vs. Dee Dee roaming animations.

skins.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide (Sub-Etha)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: The Guide's own look: 1981 phosphor CRT after dark, the 2005 movie's cream pages by day. Built into both apps.

skins.name: macOS Liquid Glass
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Liquid Glass: translucent rounded panes with a 1px specular rim, soft deep elevation, capsule pills and gauges, in graphite dark and frosted light.

skins.name: Material You (M3 Expressive)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Material 3 Expressive: tonal surface containers, 24px rounded cards, stadium pills and capsule gauges on soft elevation, in Monet lavender light and dark.

skins.name: Mirror's Edge (Runner Vision)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Clinical, high-contrast City of Glass aesthetic. Features pristine matte white surfaces, deep obsidian lines, intense Runner Vision Red accents, and Faith parkour silhouettes.

skins.name: VT-Terminal (1970s/1980s CRT)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: A DEC VT100 / IBM 3270 glass teletype: P1 green phosphor in dark mode, P3 amber in light, raster scanlines, discrete block gauges, a phosphor glow and wireframe Arthur and Marvin on the ground line.

skins.name: Windows Vista (Aero Glass)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Aero Glass: icy teal-tinted translucent panes with soft depth, rounded corners and segmented green meters, in midnight and daylight glass.

skins.name: Windows XP (Luna)
skins.author: Shani
skins.description: Luna: royal blue desktop, beige Explorer panels with a hard drop shadow, a green Start pushbutton and segmented green LED meters; Royale Noir after dark.
